title: (RHBA-2015:2001) s390utils bug fix update
portal_summary:
Updated s390utils packages that fix one bug are now available for Red Hat
Enterprise Linux 6.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM z Systems|6|s390x
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server - Extended Life Cycle Support Extension (for IBM z Systems)|6|s390x

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant
to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user space utilities that should be used
together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

This update fixes the following bug:

* Previously, the file-system based zfcpdump feature, the "-D" option, was
unintentionally removed from the code and the partition dump feature, the "-d"
option, was unintentionally added. As a consequence, when the user attempted to
perform a Small Computer System Interface (SCSI) dump operation, the process
failed with an error message. This patch adds the "-D" option and removes the
"-d" option for zfcpdump, and the user is able to create dumps as expected.
(BZ#1271103)

Users of s390utils are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix
this bug.
